author: Claude
base: Frozen keyboard revision005 (owned source set 60335f51; SDK005 binary 4d7aa91f). Its tree is not modified.
patch: trackpad-enum-adapter.patch (applies with -p1 on top of the keyboard005 PDM1SPIHID directory)
staging: Stage observation_layout.h, core/m1tp_enum.h and core/m1tp_enum.c next to PDM1SPIHID.cpp in src/Kernel/Extensions/PDM1SPIHID/ (CMake lists m1tp_enum.c and includes the source directory). All other keyboard005 files, including Info.plist and the board/PIO/protocol sources, are byte-identical inputs.
behaviour: probe: pdm1kbd=1 AND pdm1trackpadenum=1 are both required before the existing one-shot OSCompareAndSwap claim.
waitResponse: m1tp_claim_request five-key one-use mask (31); single outstanding request, no ID echo, no retry and the existing response matcher are unchanged.

enumerate: after the keyboard descriptor copy, enumerateTrackpad issues exactly two read queries, (0xd0,0x20,0x02,0x02,512) then (0xd0,0x20,0x10,0x02,512). It records stage/result, a raw 16-byte header (no strings), metadata/descriptor payload lengths and a 1..512-byte owned descriptor copy. Any failure fails the experimental start (fail-closed).

handleStart: after the gate returns (success or failure) and before interfaces/timer, one plain OSData copy of the 556-byte snapshot is set on the provider (IOResources) and on self, with request_mask = used keys; the raw result is never modified; a failed copy fails start. No publishResource, registerService or notifier.
Unchanged: only the keyboard IOHIDDevice is published, the poll loop, board/PIO/protocol/teardown/callbacks and Info.plist. No feature/SET/output/actuator request, no mode switch, no child device.
